data_objects.name: county_election_vote_results
data_objects.meaning: Election vote totals, party vote shares, and party-margin fields by state and county or county-equivalent geographic code.
data_objects.notes: The contest and election year are not identified in the declared evidence.

variables.name: votes_dem
variables.meaning: Votes recorded for the Democratic party or candidate.

variables.name: votes_gop
variables.meaning: Votes recorded for the Republican party or candidate.

variables.name: total_votes
variables.meaning: Total votes recorded for the geographic row, used as the denominator for the party shares.

variables.name: per_dem
variables.meaning: Democratic vote share of total_votes, stored as a decimal proportion.

variables.name: per_gop
variables.meaning: Republican vote share of total_votes, stored as a decimal proportion.

variables.name: diff
variables.meaning: Unsigned vote-count gap between votes_dem and votes_gop, stored as comma-formatted text.

variables.name: per_point_diff
variables.meaning: Unsigned percentage-point gap between per_dem and per_gop, stored as text with a percent sign.

variables.name: state_abbr
variables.meaning: Two-letter state abbreviation for the geographic row.

variables.name: county_name
variables.meaning: County, county-equivalent, or aggregate geographic label within the state.

variables.name: combined_fips
variables.meaning: Combined state-and-county FIPS-style geographic identifier, represented as numeric-looking text without guaranteed leading-zero padding.

structure.description: Each row represents one coded county, county-equivalent, or aggregate geography; combined_fips is the candidate row key, while county_name alone is not a reliable identifier.
Rows are grouped by state_abbr. per_dem and per_gop are proportions of total_votes, while diff and per_point_diff encode the corresponding unsigned party gap in different formats.
combined_fips is an identifier rather than a time or measured quantity; formatting as numeric-looking text can suppress leading zeros.

uncertainties: The evidence does not name the election contest, office, or election year, and total_votes is not labeled as a two-party-only total.
Some county_name values can describe an aggregate or recur across distinct combined_fips codes, so the exact geographic treatment of those rows is not documented.
annotation_notes: Semantics are grounded only in train.csv and its declared packet.
